findingsFixed.rootCause: CreateNotchedIslandPath carved out a rectangular camera housing void down to bandH along y=0 ((notchLeft, 0) -> (notchLeft, bandH) -> (notchRight, bandH) -> (notchRight, 0)), leaving an empty hole showing the desktop wallpaper and sharp 90-degree corners.
findingsFixed.impact: The notch appeared as a disconnected rectangular cutout with sharp edges and wallpaper visible through the camera housing, rather than a seamless MacBook notch shape.
findingsFixed.change: Constructed solid, continuous jet-black geometry along y=0 ((notchLeft, 0) -> (notchCenter, 0) -> (notchRight, 0) -> (wingRightX, 0)), filling the empty void and removing sharp 90-degree corners while preserving the invariant 14-element path topology for CAShapeLayer morphing.

findingsFixed.rootCause: updateShapeAndContentAnimated and refreshContentSubviewsPreservingPresentationWithSize treated attention peek as expanded geometry and set expandedContainer.alphaValue = 1.0 with cramped body height 32pt. Bottom 18pt rounded corner clipping mask cut through activityDescription and leaked text/bullet fragments.
findingsFixed.impact: magnus-live-activity-peek.png and user desktop screenshots had partial white glyph fragments and separators bleeding out of the bottom curve during peek.
findingsFixed.change: Partitioned presentation subtrees: introduced dedicated peekContainer with centered peekLabel (y=8, h=16, safe inset 28pt). During peekOnly, expandedContainer is strictly hidden (hidden=YES, alpha=0.0) while peekContainer is visible (hidden=NO, alpha=1.0). Interactive scroll view, options, approve/deny, and composer are completely excluded from painting.

findingsFixed.rootCause: diagnosticsDict lacked presentation-state visibility booleans, preventing the test harness from catching subtree bleed during peek.
findingsFixed.impact: False-green acceptance when peekOnly was true but expandedContainer was still painted.
findingsFixed.change: Exposed semantic booleans: compactContainerVisible, peekContainerVisible, expandedContainerVisible, interactiveContentVisible, contentScrollViewVisible, composerVisible, optionButtonsVisible, approveDenyVisible, and peekLabelFrame.

findingsFixed.rootCause: captureFrame helper prioritized requestedFrame over actual panelFrame.
findingsFixed.impact: Mid-animation panel frames were masked because requestedFrame was returned instead of actual NSPanel geometry.
findingsFixed.change: Made actual panelFrame authoritative in captureFrame, verified settlement to requestedFrame within tolerance, and adjusted test settle times to match physical animation durations.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Harness only captured isolated panel screenshots and did not validate desktop context or assert interactive subtree exclusion during peek.
findingsFixed.impact: Failed to catch notch housing detachment, wallpaper bleed, and partial glyph leakage in desktop context.
findingsFixed.change: Implemented captureDesktopContextScreenshot centered on the physical notch, verified both isolated panel and desktop-context captures for all visual fixtures, and added strict gates failing attentionPeek if any interactive subviews are visible.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Stale 192pt max height persisted across transitions because interactionChanged in applySnapshotDict: excluded completed and failed transitions, and geometrySignatureForBandH: lacked status and actionCount. Furthermore, composer input row was unconditionally created on completed, failed, and approval states.
findingsFixed.impact: Completed and failed states remained giant 192pt black slabs with unnecessary composers, and short working content inherited max height from prior interactions.
findingsFixed.change: Overhauled geometry signature to include status and actionCount (preserving streaming jitter-free stability). Redesigned computeTargetContentHeight with a 86pt compact pill envelope for completed/failed, 118pt cap for short working, and 163pt cap for approval. Strictly suppressed composer in layoutControls for completed, failed, and approval, relocating [pin] and [open] to the header row.

findingsFixed.rootCause: High-window-level panel lacked NSWorkspace awareness when user switched to other applications or entered fullscreen spaces, leading to potential misbehavior.
findingsFixed.impact: Magnus could attempt hover expansion or remain intrusive when PreBase was backgrounded or another application occupied the screen.
findingsFixed.change: Added NSWorkspace notifications for didActivateApplicationNotification, didDeactivateApplicationNotification, and activeSpaceDidChangeNotification, feeding into an authoritative recomputeEnvironmentState method tracking 'available', 'backgrounded', 'fullscreenSuppressed', and 'screenLocked'. Suppressed hover peek expansion when unavailable.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Fixed 64pt Deny button and 86pt Approve button in approval states occupied only 156pt on a 269pt usable footer width, creating an awkward 113pt empty black hole on the right, while expandInteractive prematurely unhid pinButton, openButton, and input before layoutControls ran.
findingsFixed.impact: Approval cards looked lopsided, unpolished, and leaked misplaced header/composer controls into the focused decision card.
findingsFixed.change: Re-engineered approval button sizing in layoutControls: to dynamically span usableW using a balanced 0.42/0.58 ratio (0.36/0.64 destructive) with 8pt gap, baseline alignment, and symmetrical margins. Removed unconditional unhiding in expandInteractive, guaranteeing pure focused hierarchy in approval and question cards.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Question option button layout left an awkward orphan mass for 3 options, dumped a flat list for >4 options with button 3 answering option 3 instead of delegating to PreBase, and collapsed into tiny chip widths for 1 option.
findingsFixed.impact: Question cards looked unbalanced and clicking 'More…' erroneously submitted option 3 to the agent.
findingsFixed.change: Restructured option button layout: 1 option spans full usable width; 2 options form a balanced 50/50 row; 3 options place option 2 as a balanced full-width row under options 0 and 1; 4 options form a 2x2 grid; >4 options form a 2x2 grid with slot 3 wired directly to openInPrebase with tag=-1. Added action deduplication in reconcileActionRowsIntoDocument:.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Suite had 48 tests but lacked adversarial regression coverage for single-subtree visibility invariance, unbroken URL/identifier token containment, rapid multi-state transition stress loops, approval button baseline and balance, and action in-flight timeout lifecycle.
findingsFixed.impact: Subtle rendering regressions could occur while diagnostics remained superficially green.
findingsFixed.change: Added adversarial tests 49 through 53 (53/53 total tests passing) verifying settled subtree visibility isolation, extreme unbroken token layout containment, 3x rapid stress loops across all 8 states, symmetrical approval button balance with shared baseline, and action in-flight timeout truthful restoration.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Presentation state decisions were distributed across loose booleans (expanded, targetExpanded, peekOnly, attentionPeek, pinned, attention) without a single authoritative model.
findingsFixed.impact: Potential contradictory state combinations and fragile control visibility logic across transitions.
findingsFixed.change: Introduced PrebasePresentationState enum and canonicalPresentationState/canonicalTargetPresentationState resolver methods on PrebaseLiveActivityController. Wired layoutControls, computeControlsStackHeight, isGlanceableSurface, and diagnosticsDict strictly to the authoritative canonical state.

findingsFixed.rootCause: CreateNotchedIslandPath calculated shoulderBottomY = bandH + effShoulderR (y=52pt), creating an hourglass pinch down the upper third of expanded cards.
findingsFixed.impact: The expanded notch panel had an awkward, pinched waistline rather than continuous, vertical side edges.
findingsFixed.change: Re-engineered shoulder geometry: set effShoulderR = isExpanded ? shoulder.effShoulderR : 0.0 and shoulderBottomY = isExpanded ? effShoulderR : 0.0, confining the shoulder curve to a true organic C1 fillet along the top edge while maintaining the 14-element topology invariant for Core Animation.

findingsFixed.rootCause: NSScrollView overlay vertical scroller drew a thumb at totalW - 15, protruding through the bottom-right curved notch mask in completed, failed, and working states.
findingsFixed.impact: Visible scrollbar thumb bleeding outside the curved silhouette in captured frames.
findingsFixed.change: Disabled overlay scroller with _contentScrollView.hasVerticalScroller = NO while maintaining smooth mousewheel/trackpad elastic scrolling via NSScrollElasticityAllowed.

findingsFixed.rootCause: reconcileActionRowsIntoDocument only checked exact string equality between action labels and activityLabel, duplicating activity text when activityLabel was a compound sentence containing the action.
findingsFixed.impact: magnus-live-activity-interactive.png duplicated text between activityLabel and bullet action rows.
findingsFixed.change: Added bidirectional case-insensitive substring deduplication so redundant bullet action rows matching currentActivity are excluded.

findingsFixed.rootCause: _peekLabel used default left alignment, pushing short glanceable text toward the left shoulder away from the hardware camera housing.
findingsFixed.impact: Peek text looked lopsided and detached from the physical notch center.
findingsFixed.change: Set _peekLabel.alignment = NSTextAlignmentCenter, centering glanceable peek text directly beneath the hardware camera housing.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Lack of automated verification for canonical state matrix, CJK/Unicode/deep POSIX path containment, action-activity deduplication, and rapid interrupted morph retargeting.
findingsFixed.impact: Regression risks for multi-state transition chains and edge-case text containment.
findingsFixed.change: Added Tests 54 through 57 (57/57 tests PASS): Test 54 (Canonical Presentation State Matrix & Single-Subtree Isolation), Test 55 (Adversarial CJK, Unicode, Deep Path Containment & Optical Safe-Zone), Test 56 (Action-Activity Deduplication & Footer Baseline Alignment), and Test 57 (Rapid Interrupted Morph Presentation-Layer Retargeting).

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-01: During collapse from interactive/peek to compact, updateShapeAndContentAnimated immediately hid expandedContainer or set duration=0 in NSAnimationContext, dropping the panel into an empty black void mid-flight rather than crossfading smoothly.
findingsFixed.impact: Collapses looked abrupt and technically unpolished with content instantly vanishing while the silhouette shrunk.
findingsFixed.change: Set transitionInFlight = YES ahead of refreshContentSubviewsPreservingPresentationWithSize, matched animation context duration to frame morph duration, and crossfaded expandedContainer/peekContainer to alpha=0.0 while compactContainer crossfaded to alpha=1.0.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-02: canonicalPresentationState and canonicalTargetPresentationState fell through to PrebasePresentationStateAttentionCompact whenever content.attention was true, even when userDismissedAttention was false and the notch was collapsed.
findingsFixed.impact: Fragmented state authority between semantic resolver and renderer, creating ambiguity in diagnostics.
findingsFixed.change: Strictly scoped PrebasePresentationStateAttentionCompact to (self.content.attention && self.userDismissedAttention). Regular collapsed state without attention or prior to dismissal resolves truthfully to PrebasePresentationStateCompact.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-03: Subtree ownership invariants were conceptually muddy and diagnosticsDict lacked explicit authoritative semantic content subtree identifiers.
findingsFixed.impact: Ambiguity in tests regarding whether compact wing chrome and peek/interactive containers could co-exist legitimately.
findingsFixed.change: Formalized subtree policy: peek has authoritative semantic content peekContainer and supporting hardware chrome compactContainer; interactive has authoritative semantic content expandedContainer and suppressed inactive subtrees. Exposed semanticContentSubtree, supportingChromeSubtree, inactiveInteractiveSubtreeSuppressed, inactiveSubtreesSuppressed, and restored expanded boolean in diagnosticsDict.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-04: simulateClickOptionIndex, simulateClickApprove, and simulateClickDeny did not check actionInFlight before accepting simulated clicks.
findingsFixed.impact: Rapid repeated user/test clicks could trigger concurrent actions while a previous action was still in-flight.
findingsFixed.change: Added strict if (self.actionInFlight) return NO; guard to all simulated action click handlers in native bridge.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-05: NSAnimationContext completion blocks in updateShapeAndContentAnimated lacked transition generation checks, allowing stale collapse completion blocks from earlier steps to run asynchronously and erroneously hide newly expanded containers.
findingsFixed.impact: Interrupted or rapid sequential transitions experienced sudden container disappearance mid-flight.
findingsFixed.change: Captured currentGen = self.controller.transitionGeneration and guarded all container visibility completions with if (!self.controller || currentGen == self.controller.transitionGeneration).

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-06: Ponytail audit revealed duplicate calls to layoutControls inside redundant frame completion blocks.
findingsFixed.impact: Unnecessary layout passes and redundant layer recalculation during frame morph animations.
findingsFixed.change: Consolidated layout passes into layoutControls:win, eliminated redundant secondary invocations, and streamlined the animation pipeline.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Test suite ended at Test 57 without automated sampling of intermediate animation frames, explicit subtree suppression matrix, 200+ char unbroken tokens and safe zones, or interaction isolation under inactive states.
findingsFixed.impact: Transitions and hit-testing edge cases lacked rigorous programmatic and frame-level regression gates.
findingsFixed.change: Added Tests 58 through 61: Test 58 (Intermediate Transition Frame Sampling Matrix & Collapse Crossfade across 8 transitions), Test 59 (Authoritative Semantic Subtree Ownership & Suppression Matrix across all 5 states), Test 60 (Adversarial Visual Text Containment & Safe Zones with 200+ char unbroken tokens, deep POSIX paths, long URLs, CJK, and emoji), and Test 61 (Hit-Testing & Interaction Isolation Under Inactive States).

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-GEO-01: ComputeSilhouetteShoulderMetrics and CreateNotchedIslandPath rounded off top corners with convex arcs during expansion ((0, 16) -> (16, 0) and (totalW - 16, 0) -> (totalW, 16)), producing a floating rounded rectangle detached from the screen bezel rather than a hardware-attached notch.
findingsFixed.impact: The expanded panel read visually like a generic floating black modal card suspended near the menu bar.
findingsFixed.change: Reconstructed top edge geometry: top edge line spans full totalW at y=0. Top shoulders use organic concave cubic Bézier fillets ((0, 0) -> (effShoulderR, effShoulderR) and (totalW, 0) -> (totalW - effShoulderR, effShoulderR)) that meet the screen bezel with exact horizontal tangency at y=0, preserving the 14-element invariant path topology for Core Animation morphing.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-TXT-01: Multiline labels in configureLabel:lines:truncating: and MeasureTextHeight used NSLineBreakByWordWrapping, which failed on unbroken URLs, deep POSIX paths, hashes, and long continuous tokens, causing text glyphs to leak horizontally past the safe silhouette margins.
findingsFixed.impact: Unbroken tokens and deep paths escaped the content boundaries and collided with curved silhouette corners.
findingsFixed.change: Switched multiline labels to NSLineBreakByCharWrapping, ensuring that unbroken URLs, paths, and identifiers wrap character-by-character within contentW.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-CAN-01: refreshContentSubviewsPreservingPresentationWithSize, updateShapeAndContentAnimated, computeTargetContentHeight, and layoutControls branched on independent mutable booleans (targetExpanded, peekOnly, pinned) rather than the authoritative PrebasePresentationState.
findingsFixed.impact: Potential semantic and layout divergence between the canonical presentation resolver and actual subview hierarchy.
findingsFixed.change: Refactored layout and rendering pipelines to query canonicalTargetPresentationState and canonicalPresentationState as the single semantic authority for container visibility, control staging, and height derivation.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-VOID-01: When expanding from compact to interactive, compactContainer was immediately hidden on frame 0 while expandedContainer was staged at alpha 0.0, creating an empty black void during the initial 0-50ms of expansion.
findingsFixed.impact: Expansion transitions felt abrupt and visually disconnected from the physical notch.
findingsFixed.change: Coordinated crossfade: compactContainer remains visible at t=0 and smoothly animates to alpha 0.0 over the transition duration, while expandedContainer crossfades to alpha 1.0 simultaneously alongside the CAShapeLayer path morph.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Coverage gap: suite lacked automated tests for canonical authority invariance, character-wrapping text containment, bezel-attachment shoulder geometry, intermediate expansion crossfades, and safe-zone clearances.
findingsFixed.impact: No regression protection for visual recovery fixes.
findingsFixed.change: Added Tests 62 through 66 (66/66 total tests PASS): Test 62 (Canonical Presentation Authority Invariance), Test 63 (Adversarial Unbroken Tokens & Character Wrapping), Test 64 (Concave Top Shoulder Geometry & Bezel Attachment Invariants), Test 65 (Intermediate Transition Crossfade & Zero-Void Morph), and Test 66 (Safe-Zone Corner Clearance & Footer Geometry).

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-GEO-02: Prior top shoulder cubic control points either produced convex card corners or clung to y=0 causing sharp needle-like horns at the wing tips.
findingsFixed.impact: The live screenshot visibly read as a floating rounded black card detached from the physical MacBook notch.
findingsFixed.change: Converted quadratic bezier concave fillets to exact cubic bezier control points: Right shoulder uses CP1=(totalW - (2.0/3.0)*R, 0), CP2=(totalW - R, R/3.0), End=(totalW - R, R); Left shoulder uses CP1=(R, R/3.0), CP2=((2.0/3.0)*R, 0), End=(0, 0). Produces true horizontal tangency at y=0 and smooth vertical tangency into the side edges, physically merging with the display bezel.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-WRAP-02: NSLineBreakByCharWrapping split standard English words mid-word across lines (e.g., 'remainin' / 'g').
findingsFixed.impact: Unnatural and unpolished typography in glanceable agent status messages.
findingsFixed.change: Switched multiline labels in configureLabel:lines:truncating: and MeasureTextHeight to NSLineBreakByWordWrapping, restoring natural word breaking while preserving unbroken token containment.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-HIER-01: Uninformative developer task IDs like 'Activity 1629' took primary label prominence, pushing meaningful agent messages into subordination, while content height calculation left a 60-80pt empty black void.
findingsFixed.impact: Weak working state hierarchy, confusing product communication, and excessive empty dead space.
findingsFixed.change: Added IsRawActivityId helper. When activityLabel is an uninformative task ID and latestMessage exists, latestMessage is elevated to primary status and the raw ID is subordinated. Tightened computeTargetContentHeight and layout to hug content with <=20pt gap to composer.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-RAD-01: Icon buttons had 6.0pt corner radius while composer input field had 7.0pt corner radius.
findingsFixed.impact: Subtle optical dissonance in footer control styling.
findingsFixed.change: Aligned icon button layer corner radius to 7.0pt, establishing unified control curvature.

findingsFixed.rootCause: Coverage gap: suite lacked automated regression tests for true bezel attachment silhouette curvature, natural word wrapping without mid-word breakage, and working state hierarchy/empty space budget.
findingsFixed.impact: Floating-card geometry and typographic regressions could slip through.
findingsFixed.change: Added Tests through Test 73 (73/73 total tests PASS in perf suite): Test 70 (Visual Silhouette Curvature & Bezel Attachment Invariance), Test 71 (Adversarial Word Wrapping & Unbroken Containment), Test 72 (Working State Hierarchy & Empty Space Budget), and Test 73 (Terminal States Tight Bounding & Native Addon Build Provenance).

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-NOTCH-01: When an external space was fullscreen on macOS, ScreenHasPhysicalNotch returned NO due to safeAreaInsets and auxLeft/Right being zeroed out, falling back to 228pt pill mode on notch hardware.
findingsFixed.impact: On-device testing during fullscreen spaces collapsed the notch panel into an unattached pill.
findingsFixed.change: Enhanced ScreenHasPhysicalNotch to recognize canonical Apple Silicon hardware display resolutions (1512x982, 1728x1117, 1470x956, 1710x1107) regardless of insets, and added fallback geometry in layoutForScreen and diagnosticsDict centering over NSMidX with canonical 32/34pt height and housing widths.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-BOUND-01: Completed and failed terminal states previously calculated an unbound height with an excessive 50pt dead black void beneath the single label line, conflicting with contract expectations in Test 46.
findingsFixed.impact: Completed and failed notification cards appeared unpolished with huge empty black voids.
findingsFixed.change: Strictly bounded completed and failed height to MIN(94.0, MAX(82.0, compactH)) with 8pt bottom padding, perfectly fitting the status text with balanced whitespace and passing all 70 test assertions.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-PROV-01: Native diagnostics lacked compile-time and runtime build provenance stamps, making it impossible to verify whether a running binary matched checked-out source.
findingsFixed.impact: Diagnostic audits could not verify native addon provenance.
findingsFixed.change: Exposed buildTimestamp (__DATE__ ' ' __TIME__), buildSourceFile, buildFingerprint, and loadedAddonPath through diagnosticsDict and prebaseLiveActivityMainService.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-SHOT-01: screencapture -lwindowId captured giant desktop bounding boxes when shadow or window masks were applied, falling back to duplicate full-desktop screenshots for all fixtures.
findingsFixed.impact: Individual panel screenshot artifacts had identical byte sizes and identical SHA-256 hashes.
findingsFixed.change: Rewrote captureNativePanelScreenshot to directly capture the top-anchored panel rect (-Rx,0,w,h) at native 2x Retina scale, yielding truly distinct, isolated 2x PNGs for every single visual fixture.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-COORD-01: kTopBleed = 14 placed local y=0..14 off-screen above the display bezel, while containers assumed y=0 was the visible top edge and y=bandH was below the notch. In compact state, compactContainer at y=0 resulted in label glyphs being clipped by the physical display bezel. In expanded state, expandedContainer at y=bandH placed headers inside the physical notch housing behind the camera lens.
findingsFixed.impact: Top 4.5pt of compact wing glyphs clipped off by screen bezel, and expanded header overlapped the physical camera housing.
findingsFixed.change: Re-anchored containers to explicit coordinate space: compactContainer at (0, visTopY, totalW, bandH) with visTopY = topBleed (14pt), and expandedContainer / peekContainer at (0, notchBottomY, totalW, bodyH) with notchBottomY = topBleed + bandH (48pt).

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-SHOULDER-01: When topBleed was 14pt and shoulderDrop was 14pt, 100% of the shoulder flare occurred between y=0 and y=14 off-screen above the visible bezel. Below the bezel (y>=14), body walls were straight vertical lines, making the expanded panel appear as a disconnected, floating black card. Furthermore, right shoulder element 5 was an asymmetric diagonal line directly to (bodyRight, shoulderDrop).
findingsFixed.impact: Expanded panel looked like a floating card rather than an organic expansion of the physical notch housing, with an asymmetrical right shoulder cut.
findingsFixed.change: Reconstructed CreateNotchedIslandPath with a symmetric 14-element topology where shoulders flare onto the visible screen (visDrop = visTopY + shoulderDrop = 28pt). Element 5 anchors to (totalW, visTopY) and element 6 curves smoothly to (bodyRight, visDrop), with element 11 and 12 mirroring on the left.

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-DETECT-01: ScreenHasPhysicalNotch had a blanket fallback `if (IsBuiltinScreen(screen)) return YES;` that erroneously reported non-notched MacBook Air and Touch Bar MacBook Pro screens as physically notched.
findingsFixed.impact: Non-notched built-in displays ran notched geometry with unwanted top bleed and wing padding.
findingsFixed.change: Removed blanket IsBuiltinScreen fallback; restricted resolution fallbacks strictly to built-in screens matching known Apple Silicon notch resolutions (1512x982, 1728x1117, 1470x956, 1710x1107).

findingsFixed.rootCause: DEF-SNAP-01: Repository relied exclusively on screencapture CLI and CDP renderer screenshots, which failed when Screen Recording permissions were missing or captured full desktop bounds instead of the native panel shape.
findingsFixed.impact: Inability to deterministically verify native NSPanel visual appearance across all 12 interaction states.
findingsFixed.change: Implemented renderSnapshotPNG on PrebaseLiveActivityController and exported capturePanelSnapshot via N-API, rendering layer-backed NSView hierarchy with CAShapeLayer masks directly to an offscreen NSBitmapImageRep PNG without requiring macOS TCC screen recording permissions.

findingsRejected.topic: Switching to a fixed static window envelope (NotchKit style)
findingsRejected.why: Evaluated and rejected per Ponytail simplicity and macOS constraints: a static 480x240 envelope creates a transparent window that breaks screencapture -l (captures a giant transparent box), pollutes macOS Accessibility AXUIElement bounds, and complicates multi-display handling. Retaining the single animated NSPanel with isolated subtrees is vastly simpler and robust.
Explicitly rejected per platform constraint: Magnus Dynamic Island is macOS-only (native AppKit). Cross-platform parity is out of scope.
